fields.title: 4. Picking up unpublished runs
fields.md:

|---|---|---|
| 11/06 (T7 deadline) | ⓓ·ⓔ deadlines passed | Re-searched (11/15 KST) — no public materials for either the ⓓ reply (11/5) or the SpaceX briefing (11/12). No newly adopted facts |
| 11/07 (8-K 5.02) | Director Harrison resigned | ① [EDGAR list](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json) — latest 3 entries: 11/13 13G/A · 11/06 8-K (5.02) · 10/26 8-K (8.01). No successor or committee disclosure |
| 11/08 (T3 expected date) | Awaiting Flight 15 | ④ LL2 — the flight took place, but there is no Ship return result yet. The 'Customer A = Google' statement continues not to be adopted (corrected 11/09) |
| 11/12 (API limit stop) | SINGULUS · Anthropic report | No additional adoption — no related 8-K on EDGAR. The items adopted on 11/14 (T14·T15) are retained. The copy's 'over €60 million' is not in the original text and continues not to be used |
